title: JFM
description: This modpack enhances vanilla gameplay while also adding Create for certain automations.
body:
Hello and welcome to JFM!

This modpack was made originally for me and a few friends to enjoy on an SMP, but it was so popular I decided to publish it.

JFM aims to enhance the vanilla Minecraft experience without changing the game mechanics entirely. The modpack includes a few optimization mods (such as Sodium and Lithium). It also features Create (and addons) as well as a lot (and I do mean a lot) of Vanilla+ mods such as Better Archaeology, Dungeons and Taverns, armor and weapon mods, and so much more.

I hope you enjoy the modpack! Please let me know if there's anything that needs changes by DMing me on Discord (@james_theGreat1) and letting me know what I can do to fix it.

P.S.
If you use the modpack you don't need to credit me but it would be much appreciated! <3
